# SLST Prophet21 Proxy — Swift PC Setup

Copy this whole folder to the Swift warehouse PC (USB stick, OneDrive, email, etc.).

## Requirements

- Windows PC on **Swift WiFi** (connect **FortiClient VPN** if OData still fails)
- PowerShell 5.1+ (built into Windows)
- No Node.js required (uses `server.ps1`)

## Setup (5 minutes)

1. Unzip this package to a folder, e.g. `C:\SLST\p21-proxy`

2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`:

   ```powershell
   cd C:\SLST\p21-proxy
   Copy-Item .env.example .env
   notepad .env
   ```

3. Edit `.env` and set at least:
   - `P21_USERNAME` = your Prophet21 login
   - `P21_PASSWORD` = your Prophet21 password

   Leave `P21_BASE_URL` as `https://swiftsupply.epicordistribution.com`
   `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` are already filled for SLST.

4. Start the proxy (leave this window open):

   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\start-proxy.ps1
   ```

   You should see: `P21 proxy listening on http://127.0.0.1:8787/`

5. Optional health check (new PowerShell window):

   ```powershell
   cd C:\SLST\p21-proxy
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\discover-p21-endpoints.ps1
   ```

   Token should be `[OK]`. If OData lines say `[FAIL] 404`, connect FortiClient VPN and/or ask IT to enable OData for your P21 user.

6. On that same PC, open the SLST website in Chrome/Edge:
   https://staginglogshippingtracker.github.io/staging-tracker/

   Click any SO → **Order History**.
   With the proxy running, insights load and publish to Supabase for the whole team.

## Do not

- Commit or email a filled `.env` with your real password
- Run this on phones — only one Windows PC on Swift network needs the proxy
- Close the proxy window while warehouse staff are publishing orders

## Optional bulk sync (later)

Once OData works:

```powershell
.\sync-to-supabase.ps1
# or schedule:
.\install-p21-sync-task.ps1
```

## Files in this package

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `start-proxy.ps1` | Starts the local P21 proxy |
| `server.ps1` | Proxy implementation (PowerShell) |
| `discover-p21-endpoints.ps1` | Diagnose token / OData access |
| `test-p21.ps1` | Quick token + view test |
| `sync-to-supabase.ps1` | Optional bulk sync of all SOs |
| `install-p21-sync-task.ps1` | Optional Windows scheduled task |
| `.env.example` | Template → copy to `.env` |
| `README.md` | Full architecture notes |
